archive_extraction.csv_values: Original strings; empty strings remain empty; no price or outcome recalculation.
archive_extraction.predicate: board_definition == cn_prophet_v4 AND horizon == 10 AND (lane == featured OR (lane == more_actionable AND lane_reasons IN [featured_cap, sector_cap]))

frozen_top_decile.additional_precision_lift_definition: Ratio of the two date-weighted precisions, plus their percentage-point difference; not the mean of per-date ratios.
frozen_top_decile.date_weighting: Equal weight per date for both selected precision and full-pool precision.
frozen_top_decile.k_rule: ceil(0.1 * original common-feature eligible pool_n), before outcome lookup
frozen_top_decile.lift_definition: Primary commission metric: equal-date-weighted mean of (frozen decile mean excess_cc minus the same original eligible pool mean excess_cc), in percentage points.

return_lift_bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive paired date-cluster interval. Does not fully correct serially overlapping holding periods or repeated issuers; not adjusted for five-arm multiplicity.
return_lift_bootstrap.resampling_unit: One entire date, retaining the paired selected-minus-pool difference; sample ten dates with replacement for each replicate.
return_lift_bootstrap.rng: Python standard-library random.Random(seed).choices; one shared sequence of date-index resamples.

intended_intel_tiebreak_top6.policy_source: Integrated source-policy review supplied by the parent; stored prophet_score is the secondary v3 score in this diagnostic.
intended_intel_tiebreak_top6.scope: One separately labeled intended-policy top-six tie-break check; identical original common pools.

limits: Current adjusted-price snapshot, not archived point-in-time price vintages; intraday execution/liquidity and terminal delisting outcomes not certified.
Board dates and selected features have no per-record UTC publication receipt or source SHA.
Date-block intervals retain all names from sampled dates but do not fully correct serially overlapping holdings or repeated issuers.
Recorded board definitions must remain separate. Shadow/watch results are not user recommendations.
Close/close alternative defines h elapsed market sessions AFTER next-session-close entry, so it is deliberately not the production H10 measure.
All results are conditional on the accepted feature-complete cohort and completeness gates. No new point-in-time proof is provided.
Top-six has a sector cap of four; top-decile deliberately has no sector cap. These are separately labeled ranking diagnostics, not an optimization.
Selected name/date observations can overlap or repeat issuers; they are not independent trades. No net costs, portfolio weights, 24-name board performance, or executable alpha are claimed.
New return-lift intervals use paired date resampling with fixed seed20261009 and10,000 shared replicates; they do not fully correct serial dependence and are not multiplicity-adjusted.

scope.hit_rule: excess_cc > 0 strictly, on existing current-vintage H10 matched close/close outcomes
